name: Edge Enhanced Transparent Streamtubes
definition: A hardware accelerated algorithm representing fibre tracts as semi-transparent tubes with emphasised silhouettes. It improves the identification of individual fibre tracts and their 3D arrangement by revealing inner structures and softening silhouette edges.
summary: Edge Enhanced Transparent Streamtubes is a hardware-accelerated technique that renders semi-transparent tubes with emphasized silhouettes to improve fiber tract identification and reduce visual cluttering in dense scenes.
